acks.reason: Bixlenvo (bictegravir/lenacapavir) approval, already published as GILD-2026-08-27. Shared-ingredient hit on the SEPARATE once-weekly oral Yeztugo application (goal 2027-02-02), which remains pending; no approval news for that application as of 2026-09-02.

ZORYVE (roflumilast) cream 0.3% for paediatric plaque psoriasis, already published as ARQT-2026-06-29. The hit is against the SEPARATE ZORYVE cream 0.05% sNDA for infants aged 3-24 months (goal 2027-02-23), which remains pending -- Arcutis' 8-K of 2026-08-05 names both applications separately. Not a missed decision. Reviewed 2026-09-14.

Joenja (leniolisib) paediatric sNDA S-006 (children 4-11 weighing 27 kg or more), already published as PHAR-2026-09-11 against the 2026-10-24 goal. The hit is against the SEPARATE lower-dose sNDA (children from 13 kg, goal 2027-01-30), accepted per Pharming's 6-K of 2026-09-25 -- two weeks AFTER this approval, so it cannot be its decision. Reviewed 2026-09-26.

Drugs@FDA NDA 216196 SUPPL-7 (PYRUKYND), approved 2026-09-28, class MANUF (CMC): a manufacturing supplement, not a decision on the RISE UP efficacy filing (goal 2026-11-01), which remains pending. Verified on openFDA 2026-10-03 (audit 10-03 Tier 0).

Drugs@FDA ANDA 220597 ORIG-1, NOVITIUM PHARMA, generic EVEROLIMUS, approved 2026-09-21: a third-party generic of the combination partner, not Roche's giredestrant + everolimus NDA (goal 2026-12-18), which remains pending. Verified on openFDA 2026-10-03 (audit 10-03 Tier 0).

Enspryng TED supplement (BLA 761149 S-008), already published as RHHBY-2026-10-15 and now FDA-dated from the letter. The hit was raised against the SEPARATE MOGAD row (goal 2027-01-10), which stays pending.
